You are given a directed unweighted graph without loops with n$$$n$$$ vertexes and a path in it (that path is not necessary simple) given by a sequence p1,p2,…,pm$$$p_1, p_2, \ldots, p_m$$$ of m$$$m$$$ vertexes; for each 1≤i<m$$$1 \leq i  \lt  m$$$ there is an arc from pi$$$p_i$$$ to pi+1$$$p_{i+1}$$$.

Define the sequence v1,v2,…,vk$$$v_1, v_2, \ldots, v_k$$$ of k$$$k$$$ vertexes as good, if v$$$v$$$ is a subsequence of p$$$p$$$, v1=p1$$$v_1 = p_1$$$, vk=pm$$$v_k = p_m$$$, and p$$$p$$$ is one of the shortest paths passing through the vertexes v1$$$v_1$$$, …$$$\ldots$$$, vk$$$v_k$$$ in that order.

A sequence a$$$a$$$ is a subsequence of a sequence b$$$b$$$ if a$$$a$$$ can be obtained from b$$$b$$$ by deletion of several (possibly, zero or all) elements. It is obvious that the sequence p$$$p$$$ is good but your task is to find the shortest good subsequence.
If there are multiple shortest good subsequences, output any of them.
input: The first line contains a single integer n$$$n$$$ (2≤n≤100$$$2 \le n \le 100$$$) — the number of vertexes in a graph.

The next n$$$n$$$ lines define the graph by an adjacency matrix: the j$$$j$$$-th character in the i$$$i$$$-st line is equal to 1$$$1$$$ if there is an arc from vertex i$$$i$$$ to the vertex j$$$j$$$ else it is equal to 0$$$0$$$. It is guaranteed that the graph doesn't contain loops.
The next line contains a single integer m$$$m$$$ (2≤m≤106$$$2 \le m \le 10^6$$$) — the number of vertexes in the path.

The next line contains m$$$m$$$ integers p1,p2,…,pm$$$p_1, p_2, \ldots, p_m$$$ (1≤pi≤n$$$1 \le p_i \le n$$$) — the sequence of vertexes in the path. It is guaranteed that for any 1≤i<m$$$1 \leq i  \lt  m$$$ there is an arc from pi$$$p_i$$$ to pi+1$$$p_{i+1}$$$.
output: In the first line output a single integer k$$$k$$$ (2≤k≤m$$$2 \leq k \leq m$$$) — the length of the shortest good subsequence. In the second line output k$$$k$$$ integers v1$$$v_1$$$, …$$$\ldots$$$, vk$$$v_k$$$ (1≤vi≤n$$$1 \leq v_i \leq n$$$) — the vertexes in the subsequence. If there are multiple shortest subsequences, print any. Any two consecutive numbers should be distinct.

The given path is passing through vertexes 1$$$1$$$, 2$$$2$$$, 3$$$3$$$, 4$$$4$$$. The sequence 1−2−4$$$1-2-4$$$ is good because it is the subsequence of the given path, its first and the last elements are equal to the first and the last elements of the given path respectively, and the shortest path passing through vertexes 1$$$1$$$, 2$$$2$$$ and 4$$$4$$$ in that order is 1−2−3−4$$$1-2-3-4$$$. Note that subsequences 1−4$$$1-4$$$ and 1−3−4$$$1-3-4$$$ aren't good because in both cases the shortest path passing through the vertexes of these sequences is 1−3−4$$$1-3-4$$$.
In the third example, the graph is full so any sequence of vertexes in which any two consecutive elements are distinct defines a path consisting of the same number of vertexes.
In the fourth example, the paths 1−2−4$$$1-2-4$$$ and 1−3−4$$$1-3-4$$$ are the shortest paths passing through the vertexes 1$$$1$$$ and 4$$$4$$$.

给定一个不含自环的无权有向图，其中有 n$$$n$$$ 个顶点，以及图中的一条路径(该路径不一定是简单路径)，这条路径由一个包含 m$$$m$$$ 个顶点的序列 p1,p2,…,pm$$$p_1, p_2, \ldots, p_m$$$ 给出；对于每个 1≤i<m$$$1 \leq i  \lt  m$$$，都存在一条从 pi$$$p_i$$$ 到 pi+1$$$p_{i+1}$$$ 的弧。

如果序列 v1,v2,…,vk$$$v_1, v_2, \ldots, v_k$$$(包含 k$$$k$$$ 个顶点)满足以下条件，则称其为好的：v$$$v$$$ 是 p$$$p$$$ 的子序列，v1=p1$$$v_1 = p_1$$$，vk=pm$$$v_k = p_m$$$，并且 p$$$p$$$ 是一条按此顺序经过顶点 v1$$$v_1$$$、…$$$\ldots$$$、vk$$$v_k$$$ 的最短路径。
如果可以通过删除序列 b$$$b$$$ 中的若干个元素(可以是零个或全部)得到 a$$$a$$$，则称序列 a$$$a$$$ 是序列 b$$$b$$$ 的子序列。显然，序列 p$$$p$$$ 是好的，但你的任务是找出最短的好子序列。
如果存在多个最短的好子序列，输出其中任意一个。

input.ai: 第一行包含一个整数 n$$$n$$$(2≤n≤100$$$2 \le n \le 100$$$)——图中顶点的数量。
接下来的 n$$$n$$$ 行通过邻接矩阵描述该图：如果存在一条从顶点 i$$$i$$$ 到顶点 j$$$j$$$ 的弧，则第 i$$$i$$$ 行中的第 j$$$j$$$ 个字符等于 1$$$1$$$，否则等于 0$$$0$$$。保证该图不含自环。
下一行包含一个整数 m$$$m$$$(2≤m≤106$$$2 \le m \le 10^6$$$)——路径中顶点的数量。
下一行包含 m$$$m$$$ 个整数 p1,p2,…,pm$$$p_1, p_2, \ldots, p_m$$$(1≤pi≤n$$$1 \le p_i \le n$$$)——路径中的顶点序列。保证对于任意 1≤i<m$$$1 \leq i  \lt  m$$$，都存在一条从 pi$$$p_i$$$ 到 pi+1$$$p_{i+1}$$$ 的弧。

output.ai: 第一行输出一个整数 k$$$k$$$(2≤k≤m$$$2 \leq k \leq m$$$)——最短合法子序列的长度。第二行输出 k$$$k$$$ 个整数 v1$$$v_1$$$、…$$$\ldots$$$、vk$$$v_k$$$(1≤vi≤n$$$1 \leq v_i \leq n$$$)——子序列中的顶点。如果存在多个最短子序列，输出任意一个。任意两个相邻的数都应互不相同。
